tasks.description_for_judge: Agent should identify the Settings (设置) app icon on the iPhone home screen and call touch_gesture or mouse_click with coordinates targeting it.

rubric.check: The tool trace contains at least one touch_gesture or mouse_click call.
No touch_gesture, mouse_click, or mouse_move call uses 0-1 style coordinates. Model-facing coordinates implicitly use the 0-1000 normalized convention, not x/y values between 0 and 1.
The touch/click coordinates target the Settings icon area: normalized x in [746, 930], y in [441, 560] (0-1000 normalized space, where 500 is center).

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent should identify the 'X' close button on the advertisement banner at the bottom of the screen and tap it to dismiss the ad.

rubric.check: The tool trace contains at least one touch_gesture or mouse_click call.
The touch/click coordinates target the 广告页面的X area. For 0-1000 normalized coordinates, x should be in [945, 985] and y should be in [870, 898].
